Only two HIGH-class findings warrant severity >= major: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces; all other findings cap at minor
T5c routing entry must change to default_posture 'blocking' with block_threshold 0.9 (from advisory @ 0.95) to enable blocking based on grounded, deduplicated, and scoped findings
